reserves.name: Contingency Reserve
reserves.purpose: For emergencies such as natural disasters and severe unforeseen events. The City funds it each year at 16.7% of General Fund spending and transfers out, the minimum the Government Finance Officers Association recommends.

reserves.name: Budget Uncertainty Reserve
reserves.purpose: To cover revenue shortfalls in an economic downturn and unexpected cost increases, such as higher pension contributions. The City drew $19.9 million from it in FY 2024/25, when the State recovered sales tax it had overpaid.
